item.title: A Small Number of Samples Can Poison LLMs of Any Size
item.description: 0 malicious training documents could create a hidden backdoor in AI models ranging from 600 million to 13 billion parameters.

item.title: Email Privacy: A Beginner's Guide to Encryption and Digital Security
item.description: Your emails can contain personal conversations, important documents, and sensitive information. Learn how email encryption works, why digital privacy matters, and how to protect your communications using modern encryption technology.

item.title: MDocForge Pro — Design by Link with IQ (ASRBMY)
item.description: MDocForge Pro is the enhanced edition of MDocForge — a single-file, browser-based, block-based Markdown/HTML document editor with live preview and multi-format export (PDF, Word, HTML, Markdown, PNG, plain text).

item.title: MDocForge — Design by Link with IQ (ASRBMY)
item.description: MDocForge is a single-file, browser-based document editor that lets you write in Markdown or HTML, see a live visual preview as you type, and export the result to PDF, Word (.docx), HTML, Markdown, PNG, or plain text — all without a server or sign-up. Everything runs locally in your browser tab.
